documents.title: docs/configuration/configuration.md > Configuration file > `<remote_write>`
documents.text:
### `<remote_write>`

`write_relabel_configs` is relabeling applied to samples before sending them
to the remote endpoint. Write relabeling is applied after external labels. This
could be used to limit which samples are sent.

There is a [small demo](/documentation/examples/remote_storage) of how to use
this functionality.

```yaml
# The URL of the endpoint to send samples to.
url: <string>

# protobuf message to use when writing to the remote write endpoint.
#
# * The `prometheus.WriteRequest` represents the message introduced in Remote Write 1.0, which
# will be deprecated eventually.
# * The `io.prometheus.write.v2.Request` was introduced in Remote Write 2.0 and replaces the former,
# by improving efficiency and sending metadata, start timestamp and native histograms by default.
#
# Before changing this value, consult with your remote storage provider (or test) what message it supports.
# Read more on https://prometheus.io/docs/specs/remote_write_spec_2_0/#io-prometheus-write-v2-request
[ protobuf_message: <prometheus.WriteRequest | io.prometheus.write.v2.Request> | default = prometheus.WriteRequest ]

# EXPERIMENTAL: Remote-Write 2.0 mode to use when `protobuf_message` is `io.prometheus.write.v2.Request`.
#
# * `none`: default Remote-Write 2.0 behavior with no additional restrictions.
# * `stateless`: appends `;mode=stateless` to the Content-Type header, defaults `send_native_histograms` to `true`,
#   requires `--enable-feature=metadata-wal-records` or `--enable-feature=type-and-unit-labels`, and drops classic
#   histogram float series, series with unspecified metadata type, and all exemplars (until sample-exemplar coalescing
#   is implemented, as `stateless` mode forbids detached exemplars).
# * `stateless-st`: appends `;mode=stateless-st` to the Content-Type header, includes all `stateless` rules,
#   additionally requires `--enable-feature=st-storage`, and drops cumulative metrics missing a start timestamp.
#
# Support for metadata relabeling (https://github.com/prometheus/proposals/pull/104) is coming to allow relabeling
# untyped series (such as recording rule outputs) to `counter` or `gauge` (relabeling `__type__` already works when
# `--enable-feature=type-and-unit-labels` is enabled).
#
# Read more on https://prometheus.io/docs/specs/prw/remote_write_spec_2_0/#modes
[ mode: <none | stateless | stateless-st> | default = none ]

documents.title: documentation/examples/remote_storage/example_write_adapter/README.md > Remote Write Adapter Example
documents.text:
## Remote Write Adapter Example

This is a simple example of how to write a server to
receive samples from the remote storage output.

To use it:

```
go build

./example_write_adapter
```

...and then add the following to your `prometheus.yml`:

```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: "http://localhost:1234/receive"
    protobuf_message: "io.prometheus.write.v2.Request"
```

or for the eventually deprecated Remote Write 1.0 message:

```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: "http://localhost:1234/receive"
    protobuf_message: "prometheus.WriteRequest"
```

Then start Prometheus (in separate terminal):

```
./prometheus --enable-feature=metadata-wal-records
```
